about_the_game:
WELCOME TO FOCUS GROVE

Focus Grove isn’t just a game — it’s your companion for staying mindful, balanced, and productive throughout the day.

Send your Woodlings to grow your farm while you focus on what matters. Use mindful tools to stay centered, ambient sounds to help you focus or unwind, and build a woodland farm that grows with your mood.

WORK OR STUDY WITH NO DISTRACTIONS

Easily focus on your work or studying. Play your favorite ambient track, set your focus timer and just press Start. Don’t worry, while you focus on your tasks, your animal helpers will take care of your farm for you.

GROW YOUR EVERYDAY HABITS

Have you ever had a hard time making good habits stick? Yeah, we have too. Until we designed a Habits Journal — where you can check off your habits with a nice little ‘pop’ every day.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN WITH PROGRESS

Complete your real-life tasks (and daily habits) to unlock cute outfits for your Woodlings and fun customizations for your Farm. Being productive has never been so rewarding!

BUILD A FARM OF YOUR DREAMS

Build a cozy woodland farm that grows with you. Your Woodlings work when you work and rest when you rest — so the progress you make in real life is mirrored by your farm.

KEY FEATURES

  • Use built in tools to keep track of your daily habits and real-life tasks — complete them to unlock customizations for your Woodlings and your farm.

  • Customize your woodland farm to match your mood — warm and sunny spring? golden autumn, or maybe a colorful shroomy forest?

  • Focus Timer. Gameloop sessions follow the proven Pomodoro technique for focus work. Work time: You focus on your tasks while Woodlings get busy building and farming. Break time: Woodlings rest and recharge. You do you.

  • Create the perfect focus zone by playing one of the many ambient nature tracks like Forest Spring, Gentle Storm, or even Purring Cat.

  • Write in your personal Notebook — whether you want to pour out your thoughts, jot down a great idea, or keep a gratitude journal. 

  • Visit the Zen Master every day. The Zen Master helps you grow in one of your chosen areas — Productivity, Personal Growth, or Health.

  • Unlock cute outfits and crazy new skins for your Woodlings and style them any way you want.

  • Plant trees to grow a beautiful grove — each one reflects your focus time. Before you know it, you’ll turn the grove into a lush, thriving forest.

  • And finally, together with your woodland helpers build a farm of your dreams - fields full of healthy vegetables and juicy fruits, farm buildings, roads, and cozy places for Woodlings to rest in their spare time.

  • But remember to keep your Woodlings happy — don’t overwork them, or they will be too tired to focus and work properly. Sounds familiar? Don’t worry, the Balance Tree will remind you to treat Woodlings (and yourself!) with kindness you all deserve.

name: Focus Grove

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Build your cozy forest farm… while thriving in life. Focus Grove is a mindful game that improves your focus, well-being and work-life balance. Let your Woodlings grow your farm, while you grow in life.
